alt: 青年放下原本寫作的筆與書本，換上沒有軍徽的訓練服，帶著行囊加入軍隊訓練。
scene_prompt: 投筆從戎 means leaving scholarly or writing work to join military service. Modern young ADULT, not a child. One gently flowing before-and-after composition: at LEFT a civilian study desk with an open notebook, neatly placed writing pen and simple books; at RIGHT the SAME young adult now in plain muted olive training fatigues and boots, carrying a duffel bag, walking purposefully to join a small group of adult recruits doing unarmed marching practice in the distance. A closed notebook held by his civilian past vignette links identity. No combat, rifles, weapons, flags, insignia, named forces, propaganda slogans, hero worship or text. Focus on change from writing to service.
